open_points.subject: Owner / staff actor
open_points.text: “Owner / staff” and “staff hold a staff credential”
open_points.question: Who counts as staff besides the owner, and what trust distinguishes staff from the owner who alone administers the host, vault and configuration?
options: Staff includes explicitly authorized people who may use all staff actions and contact data but cannot administer the host or configuration
Staff includes anyone given access to a tool holding the shared staff credential
open_points.default_guess: Staff includes explicitly authorized people trusted for all staff API actions and contact data, while only the owner administers hosts, secrets and configuration.

open_points.subject: Customer contact-data boundary
open_points.text: “Personal data — the customer's contact data (R0-06); readable by staff only” contradicts “every contact field it records or reads passes to the provider of the model the owner runs it on”
open_points.question: Does “readable by staff only” describe only API authorization, or must model providers also be recognized as authorized external recipients of customer contact data?
options: It describes API authorization only; an operator's model provider is an accepted external recipient
Only human staff may receive contact data, so model-backed operators cannot record or read it
Model providers are treated as part of the staff actor
open_points.default_guess: The restriction applies to API callers, while the operator's selected model provider is an explicitly accepted external data recipient rather than staff.

open_points.subject: Operator access to store and configuration
open_points.text: “An agent ... could read the store and the instance's configuration, service tokens included, itself” contradicts “An instance's configuration is set on its host, readable only by the owner and the Registry process”
open_points.question: Is an operator agent authorized to read the store, configuration and service tokens through the owner's host access, or are those resources restricted to the human owner and Registry process?
options: The agent is authorized as the owner's delegated hand
The agent may use only the Registry API and must not read host files or the store directly
The agent may read the store but not configuration or secrets
open_points.default_guess: The agent is authorized as the owner's delegated hand, so “owner” includes access exercised through that agent.

open_points.subject: Model-provider exposure beyond contact data
open_points.text: “every contact field it records or reads passes to the provider of the model” alongside “could read the store and the instance's configuration, service tokens included, itself”
open_points.question: When an agent uses host access, may store contents, configuration and service tokens pass to its model provider, or is provider exposure accepted only for customer contact fields?
options: Any data the agent reads may pass to its model provider
Contact fields may pass, but store data, configuration and secrets must not
Store records may pass, but configuration and secrets must not
open_points.default_guess: Store records needed for the task may pass to the provider, but configuration and secrets must not be exposed to it.
